doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Riverside and the New York scene
title: The Chicago Sound night at Birdland
summary: Birdland packs a Chicago Sound night; personnel change as Campbell and Mance leave.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, I said we did this Chicago Sound, and the next thing I knew they had a big Chicago Sound night down at Birdland. So I go there and oh boy, the place was packed -- I mean with news people, reporters; I don't know what reaction -- I don't know whether they were promoting the record or the record had been out for some time, and, we got a very favorable mention, I know that.

And Wilbur Campbell went back to Chicago, and Frankie Dunlap made one side of the record, too, because Wilbur had to leave the next month after the initial side, and Junior Mance had left, and so we used Kenny Drew down at Birdland, but it was a beautiful night, and amost every other night, I had ... Monday night I had a job down there.
